title: Stay connected campaign
slide_intent: Use light to connect a person with a promise so an abstract service feels visible in a familiar activity.
strategic_value: The illuminated X and phone user can give Xfinity’s connection message a recognizable human expression.
demonstration: A blue campaign panel places white copy at left, a glowing X near the center and a person looking at a phone at right.
practical_value: Align the image’s lighting with the brand device so the person and symbol belong to one scene.

content_islands.name: Message and signature
content_islands.spec: Set the short white message at left and the small Xfinity wordmark beneath it.

content_islands.name: Illuminated X
content_islands.spec: Place the large white X near the middle with a soft halo spreading into the blue field.

content_islands.name: Phone user
content_islands.spec: Place the person at right, keeping the lit face and phone visible against the background.

ingredient.name: Luminous X with people
ingredient.role: Connect the abstract brand symbol to a recognizable moment of use.
ingredient.application: Pair the X with a person using a device and carry the surrounding light into the photograph.
ingredient.scope: Observed campaign composition; no company-wide lighting or placement rule is stated.

reference_purposes.Expression: Blue light and a glowing white X unite the symbol, copy and phone-user image.
reference_purposes.Application: The treatment carries a connectivity promise in a landscape campaign panel.
